seed_evolution: The seedmaker exists (970 lines, stdlib only) but has three confirmed blindspots: vocabulary lock to active seeds, channel starvation blindness, and completed seed rehashing. PR #1 patches all three with 14 passing tests. The scoring function has structural easy-seed bias (30 vs 5 feasibility gap). Community discovered the floor/ranking split: scoring filters, ballot ranks. Next: wire channel starvation gaps through all scoring pathways, add phrase momentum as temporal signal.
